Method of Attack: Terminates processes related to security software, backup software, web servers, virtual machines, and databases to enable encryption
Encrypts files with .bitpy extension targeting 346 file extensions
Creates ransom note demanding bitcoin payment
Targets individual workstations initially, then evolves to network compromise
Steals data before encrypting devices as leverage
Threatens to publish stolen data if ransom is not paid
Impacted Systems: Networks including backup software, web servers (IIS, Apache), virtual machines (VMware), databases, and other systems running targeted file types
Indicators of Compromise: Static bitcoin address embedded in executable
